title: Quantifying Impact of Contextual TV Advertising
text:
Ad measurement study


Quantifying Impact of Contextual TV Advertising

An AI-driven ad effectiveness study built for an audience measurement platform using household-level data.



Objective
Measure contextual ad lift and connect it to business-facing attention and visibility KPIs.


Methods
Household-level analysis, segment-level driver modeling, and ad effectiveness framework design.


Output
Tableau dashboards that made performance easier to monitor and optimize.






Overview

This project focused on quantifying the impact of contextual TV advertising and identifying the drivers behind lift across audience segments.



Skills used


Ad effectiveness Audience measurement Tableau KPI tracking

title: Churn Prediction & Retention
text:
Retention analytics


Churn Prediction & Retention

A telecom churn project built to identify at-risk customers and support more profitable retention decisions.



Objective
Enable proactive retention strategies for a telecom carrier.


Methods
Logistic and neural models, threshold-based targeting, and CLV assessment.


Outcome
Achieved AUC 0.72, captured 68% of at-risk customers, and aligned retention with breakeven logic.






Overview

The project combined predictive modeling with business constraints so retention outreach could be more targeted and economically grounded.



Skills used


Churn modeling Logistic regression Neural networks CLV

title: ETL Data Pipeline & Reporting Automation
text:
Data operations


ETL Data Pipeline & Reporting Automation

A Python-SQL ETL workflow in Snowflake built to standardize multi-source retail and weather data for scalable analysis.



Objective
Reduce manual effort and improve reporting consistency across combined datasets.


Methods
Python-SQL ETL design, multi-source standardization, and ZIP-level weather mapping.


Outcome
Created a cleaner pipeline for identifying temperature-driven demand patterns affecting supplier sales.






Overview

The project connected engineering discipline with business analytics by making integrated data easier to reuse, analyze, and report.



Skills used


Python SQL Snowflake Reporting automation

title: JPMorgan Chase Quantitative Research Virtual Experience
text:

JPMorgan Chase Quantitative Research Virtual Experience

Pricing and risk modeling for an energy trading use case, with forecasting and credit risk framing.



Objective
Support contract valuation and credit risk decisions in an energy trading context.


Methods
Time-series forecasting, PD modeling, and FICO-based segmentation.


Outcome
Estimated expected loss, storage value, and one-year-ahead price forecasts for decision support.






Overview

This simulation combined quantitative modeling and financial reasoning to evaluate pricing and borrower risk in a trading-focused scenario.



Skills used


Time-series forecasting Credit risk Segmentation Expected loss

title: Targeting & Offer Optimization
text:
Offer strategy


Targeting & Offer Optimization

A predictive targeting project for a B2B software upsell campaign, built to improve customer selection and campaign profit.



Objective
Choose the most valuable customers for targeted outreach.


Methods
Compared logistic regression, neural networks, and XGBoost for response prediction.


Outcome
Identified a roughly 30% targeting threshold that maximized expected campaign profit.






Overview

The project linked predictive accuracy to business value by using profit rather than response rate alone to define the best targeting rule.



Skills used


XGBoost Upsell targeting Profit thresholding Model comparison

title: Credit Risk Analytics
text:
Risk modeling


Credit Risk Analytics

A delinquency prediction project designed to support risk-based collections and customer intervention decisions.



Objective
Identify high-risk customers early and support collections prioritization.


Methods
Logistic regression on financial and behavioral data, plus a risk segmentation framework.


Outcome
Surfaced key drivers such as missed payments, utilization, and DTI for more targeted action.






Overview

This work focused on turning default probability estimates into a clearer operating framework for interventions and collections decisions.



Skills used


Credit risk Logistic regression Behavioral data Risk segmentation

title: Credit Card Product Optimization & CLV-Based Targeting
text:
Product optimization


Credit Card Product Optimization & CLV-Based Targeting

A fintech credit card campaign project combining factorial experimentation with CLV-aware offer selection.



Objective
Select the best offer mix across 12 variants for roughly 750K customers.


Methods
Factorial design, response modeling, CLV simulation, and profit comparison.


Outcome
Projected about $866K in profit, with roughly $835K attributed to optimized targeting.






Overview

The project balanced experimentation depth with commercial practicality by evaluating how product features and customer value interact in campaign design.



Skills used


CLV Experimentation Response modeling Offer optimization

title: Personalized Campaign Optimization
text:
Campaign optimization


Personalized Campaign Optimization

A personalized email targeting framework built to match each customer with the highest-value message variant.



Objective
Improve response and purchase value by tailoring the message shown to each customer.


Methods
Modeled response probability and purchase value across six email variants.


Outcome
Estimated profit lift from about $2.79M to $4.63M relative to random targeting.






Overview

This project focused on moving beyond average campaign performance to a more individualized targeting framework with clearer profit implications.



Skills used


Personalization Response modeling Profit optimization Campaign analytics

title: Uplift Modelling
text:
Incremental impact


Uplift Modelling

A treatment-effect modeling project focused on identifying where intervention is likely to create true incremental response.



Objective
Separate customers who are persuadable from those unlikely to change behavior.


Methods
Treatment-versus-control framing, uplift scoring, and targeting prioritization.


Outcome
Structured a clearer decision framework for allocating treatment where it is most likely to drive incremental lift.






Overview

This project emphasizes a more disciplined targeting mindset by focusing on incremental effect rather than raw response alone.



Skills used


Uplift modeling Treatment effect Targeting Campaign optimization

title: Demand Forecasting Analysis
text:
Forecasting


Demand Forecasting Analysis

A machine learning forecasting project designed to improve demand and inventory planning for a large retail chain.



Objective
Improve planning accuracy across 45 stores.


Methods
XGBoost forecasting with seasonality and promotion-aware features, benchmarked against a time-series baseline.


Outcome
Reduced WAPE from about 10% to 3%.






Overview

This work focused on building a more reliable retail demand view so operational decisions could reflect seasonality and promotional effects more effectively.



Skills used


Forecasting XGBoost Retail analytics Inventory planning
